nodes.html: Your Accountant Match is a Melbourne-based matching service that connects individuals and businesses with independent accounting firms across Australia. We are not an accounting or tax advice provider; we facilitate introductions between users and accountants in our network. The matching service is free to you — we do not charge you any fee for being matched with an accountant. This Privacy Statement explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs).

nodes.html: Our founder created Your Accountant Match because he saw a better way to introduce people to a local accountant than leaving them to choose from a directory listing. He brings more than 19 years of experience working closely with members of the National Tax & Accountants’ Association (NTAA) and accounting professionals across Australia.
